name: Checkr
summary: Checkr sells employment background checks at published per-report prices: $29.99 for Basic, $59.99 for Essential and $94.99 for Complete, before pass-through court and agency fees. Employers invite candidates by email to enter their details and consent, and larger accounts get quoted pricing with 200+ ATS integrations.

facts.text: Checkr's criminal search page describes national, state, county, federal and sex offender searches, and says its national search queries over 900 million public records.

Checkr's API documentation says it emails the candidate to invite them to provide their information and consent, and that it cannot provide a report unless the employer certifies it obtained proper authorization.
A county criminal search costs $25 per check as an add-on, and a motor vehicle record costs $9.50 per check, both before pass-through fees.
Employment verification as an add-on costs $12.50 for the current employer and $50 for ten years of history.
Its pricing page lists the Enterprise tier as custom-quoted with 200+ ATS integrations and automated adjudication.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: SSN trace, sex offender registry, global watchlist and national criminal search

plans.name: Essential
plans.notes: Adds identity verification and unlimited county criminal search

plans.name: Complete
plans.notes: Adds unlimited state criminal search and federal criminal search

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Automated adjudication, 200+ ATS integrations and customized workflows

hiddenCosts: Pass-through fees charged by courts and agencies are not included in the per-report prices.
Add-ons such as a county criminal search ($25) and a motor vehicle record ($9.50) are billed on top of the package.
